title: Senior Lead, Market Risk
description: About Pagaya Shape the Future of Finance Pagaya is building a leading artificial intelligence network to help our partners grow their businesses and better serve their customers. Pagaya is a global technology company making life-changing financial products and services available to more people nationwide, as it reshapes the financial services ecosystem. By using machine learning, a vast data network and a sophisticated AI-driven approach, Pagaya provides comprehensive consumer credit and residential real estate solutions for its partners, their customers, and investors. Its proprietary API and capital solutions integrate into its network of partners to deliver seamless user experiences and greater access to the mainstream economy. Pagaya has offices in New York and Tel Aviv. For more information, visit  pagaya.com . Let's create better outcomes together! About the Role We’re looking to add a Senior Lead, Market Risk as an integral part of the Enterprise Risk Management team, providing oversight and analytical review of Pagaya’s investment vehicles, counterparties, and overall market risks.  Responsibilities Assess performance of Pagaya’s financing vehicles (e.g., securitizations and forward flow arrangements), conducting attribution analyses, ongoing monitoring, and independent valuations Conduct market analyses and peer benchmarking, understanding broader credit industry trends as well as those of our lending partners Provide second line oversight of liquidity, funding, and risk retention decisions, as well as related performance triggers and covenants  Liaise across Portfolio Management, Research, and Finance teams to understand and mitigate relevant risks Evaluate the financial viability, creditworthiness, and operational health of third parties (e.g., lending partners, servicers, and other counterparties) Support coordination of inbound and outbound due diligence requests across lending partners  Maintain, develop, and prepare executive-level reporting on the above items through various ongoing forums and committees Requirements Undergraduate degree majoring in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or Engineering with a minimum of 8 years of experience in a consumer finance/lending institution Demonstrated experience in Credit Risk, Asset-Backed Securities, and Counterparty Risk management, with knowledge of relevant regulations and standards Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Power Point, and related Google suite tools, with ability to work with various data sources and tools. High degree of comfort preparing executive-level materials is a must Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to persuasively communicate complex issues and outstanding attention to detail Ability to independently analyze problems and formulate recommendations/conclusions Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask in a complex and dynamic environment CFA, FRM, MBA and/or other advanced credentials are a plus Familiarity with Intex and dv01 is a plus The pay ranges for New York-based hires are commensurate with candidate experience.  Pay ranges for candidates working in locations other than New York may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. Compensation Range for New York Based Hires $130,000 — $160,000 USD Our Team Pagaya was founded in 2016 by seasoned research, finance, and technology entrepreneurs with our head quarters located in NYC and Tel Aviv.  We move fast and smart, identifying new opportunities and building end-to-end solutions from AI models and unique data sources. Every Pagaya team member is solving new and exciting challenges every day in a culture based on partnership, collaboration, and community. Join a team of builders who are working every day to enable better outcomes for our partners and their customers. Our Values Continuously Learn - We challenge ourselves for the sake of getting better as individuals, as teams, and as an organization to deliver for our partners. Debate and Commit - We respectfully and openly debate to strengthen our ideas and build shared conviction - once we decide, we go all in, together. Dream Big and Act - We boldly tackle complex problems, pressure-test solutions in real-time, and adapt with speed and energy. Advance Inclusion - We create a world where everyone can win, designing systems that better represent people and generate sustainable value for our employees, partners and investors. Be   Accountable Together - We proudly own our actions and our results, taking initiative to ensure our work gets over the finish line as a team. More than just a job We believe health, happiness, and productivity go hand-in-hand. That's why we're continually looking to enhance the ways we support you with benefits programs and perks that allow every Pagayan to do the best work of their life.

title: Technical Accounting & Reporting Senior Manager
description: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for a self-motivated, detail-oriented, and technically proficient Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting Senior Manager . This individual will play a key role in supporting complex accounting matters, building scalable processes, collaborating cross-functionally, and contributing to a strong internal control and reporting environment that meets the standards of a sophisticated, fast-growing SaaS company. This is a full-time position based out of our Oakland office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. What You’ll Do Research, analyze, and document technical accounting issues and memos and prepare calculations to support accounting conclusions and facilitate external audit reviews in accordance with US GAAP, including but not limited to ASC 718 (Stock-Based Compensation), ASC 350-40 (Capitalized Software), ASC 340 (Capitalized Commissions), ASC 805 (Business Combinations), ASC 842 (Leases), and ASC 480 (Debt & Equity). Develop and maintain accounting policies and procedures, and lead implementation of significant changes. Work with external valuation specialists to ensure complex transaction valuations are completed accurately and on time, including managing inputs and reviewing deliverables for 409A valuations, intangible asset valuations, and equity award valuations. Collaborate with teams across Accounting Operations, Engineering, Finance, Legal, HR, and other departments to ensure technical guidance is consistently operationalized and understood. Support initiatives to enhance external reporting readiness, including complex accounting topics, disclosures, and process improvements. Help design and implement efficient, SOX-compliant accounting processes and internal controls to support organizational growth. Partner with external auditors and consultants to ensure timely and accurate conclusions on accounting matters. Provide training and mentorship to team members on technical accounting topics and emerging standards. Skills We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required; CPA license required 7+ years of combined experience in Big 4 public accounting and/or corporate accounting at a SaaS or high-growth technology company Demonstrated technical accounting expertise and experience drafting memos on complex, non-routine transactions Strong understanding of US GAAP and internal control frameworks (e.g., SOX) Experience working in or supporting a company with increasing external reporting, audit, or regulatory complexity Familiarity with ERP systems and financial reporting tools (Netsuite and Workiva preferred) and a mindset toward process improvement and automation Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across departments Self-starter with strong organizational skills and attention to detail; comfortable working independently in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Bonus Skills​ Prior experience as part of an S-1 filing or IPO project team. Experience with automation and AI tools to drive efficiency. #LI-JG1 #LI-Hybrid The compensation range displayed

title: Lead, Business Intelligence, Information Security Governance
description: Job Classification: Technology - Information Security Your Team Are you interested in building capabilities that enable innovation, speed, agility, scalability, and efficiency? As part of Prudential's Global Technology & Operations organization, the Information Security Governance team is building a new business intelligence capability to improve visibility into technology risk, performance, and execution. As the Lead, Business Intelligence, Information Security Governance, you will help build this capability from the ground up. This hands-on, influence-based role combines Power BI dashboard development, AI-enabled reporting, data modeling, SQL, metric governance, and stakeholder engagement to help leaders make faster, better-informed decisions. Leveraging Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Claude, and Copilot, you will deliver executive-ready insights, improve data quality, strengthen trust in critical metrics, and help shape a modern analytics capability that supports Information Security Governance. This is a unique opportunity to build scalable reporting solutions, establish operating standards, and influence how data and AI are used to drive decision-making across a highly visible organization. This role is based in our office in Newark, NJ. Our organization follows a hybrid work structure where employees can work remotely and from the office, as needed, based on demands of specific tasks or personal work preferences. This position is hybrid and requires your on-site presence on a reoccurring weekly basis at least 3 days per week. Here is What You Can Expect on a Typical Day Build Executive Reporting, Analytics & BI Capabilities Design and deliver trusted Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards, data visualizations, and AI-enabled reports that provide meaningful insights into technology risk, performance, execution, and operational priorities. Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, including data models, reporting frameworks, metric definitions, and visualization strategies. Partner with leaders and stakeholders to transform complex data into actionable insights that improve decision-making and visibility across Information Security Governance. Establish reporting standards, dashboard templates, governance practices, and delivery processes that support a growing analytics capability. Enable Data Quality, Metric Governance & Trusted Insights Develop, optimize , and troubleshoot SQL queries , relational data models, and reporting solutions to ensure reliable data extraction, transformation, and reporting performance. Apply data governance and BI best practices to strengthen metric definitions, data lineage, consistency, quality, and stakeholder confidence. Conduct testing, validation, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution to ensure dashboards and reports accurately reflect business performance and risk indicators. Define and maintain KPI, KRI, and reporting standards that improve transparency and trust in executive reporting. Advance AI-Enabled Reporting & Cross-Functional Innovation Leverage Copilot, Claude, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps to accelerate reporting, requirements gathering, insight generation, analytics workflows, and executive communications. Apply responsible AI practices, including validation, human review, and data sensitivity awareness, to ensure AI-generated outputs are accurate , secure, and actionable. Partner across Information Security, Governance, Risk, Technology, Engineering, and business teams to identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and enhanced analytics capabilities. Collaborate with teams supporting AWS, ServiceNow, Jira, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Power Automate, and other enterprise technologies to improve data integration, reporting effectiveness, and user experience. The Skills & Expertise You Bring Bachelor's degree in Mathematics , Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience designing, developing, and delivering enterprise analytics solutions using Power BI , including dashboard development, reporting, data visualization, and executive insights. Strong experience with SQL , relational databases, data modeling, data normalization, data management, and reporting performance optimization. Experience working with Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, and Claude to support analytics, reporting, and decision-making. Ability to define metrics, translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, and communicate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong stakeholder management, consulting, communication, and influence skills, with the ability to lead through partnership across business, technology, governance, and risk teams.
